blocks.text: Witches, clowns and a killer durian! Halloween in the Blue Mountains – in pictures

Each Halloween, photographer Maja Baska roams the streets of North Katoomba with her analogue camera to document the local festivities, capturing everything from the delightfully banal to the genuinely terrifying

blocks.alt: A person wears an inflatable shark costume for Halloween, peering through its mouth opening, holding a shopping bag

blocks.text: A long way from home ... you don’t see many sharks in the mountains

blocks.alt: A woman in a red shirt and a man in a party hat sit side by side in a doorway, decorated for Halloween

blocks.text: Walk down the path to find these two – tell me that is not the creepiest Halloween setup!

blocks.alt: A young girl in a turquoise mermaid costume stands by a fence near a horse
